{{Quote|Keeper, the slave ship ''Tecora'' is making an unscheduled landing on platform 2-4.|The operator to Agruss|<ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''Zygerrian''' was working as a computer operator in the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].

==Biography==
This [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] was operating a computer in the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Kadavo slave processing facility]] and informed the commander of the unit, [[Agruss/Legends|Agruss]], that the slave ship [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']] was making an unscheduled landing on one of the landing pads. This operator later informed Agruss that a fleet of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] have dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in sector 6.
